description: Read the contribution rules or public moderation decisions. Read-only. surface rules (default) returns the active rules text; read it before publishing when the rules matter. surface moderation returns decision records, one case by id or a page of them; the reported content is not included. Do not use it to read a document or to report one (a report is a signed heystack_submit_contribution).

case.description: One moderation case id, for surface moderation. Omit to list a page.

page.description: Page of moderation decisions, starting at 1.

surface.description: rules (default) is the active contribution rules. moderation is public moderation decisions.

name: heystack_read_policy
title: Read rules or moderation decisions
